findings.description: Roughly 3-4 s of continuous coffee stream goes into the mug (00:27.8-00:31), but the carafe's upright fill level after the pour (about 55-60% of the bulb at 00:31.2) looks the same as before it (00:27.125), with no visible drop to account for a mug's worth of coffee leaving. Same close-up framing, so perspective is less likely to explain it, but carafe tilt and distance changes slightly and a single mug from a large carafe would only cause a small drop, so the evidence is weak.
